en.description: Routing and cache configuration for GitHub reads.
en.hint.cacheTtlContent: Cache seconds for near-immutable content (files, commits, diffs).
en.hint.cacheTtlMeta: Cache seconds for PR/issue metadata (0 = no cache).
en.hint.mirrors: E.g. https://ghproxy.net; separate several with commas.
en.hint.proxy: Empty = inherit ambient proxy env; 'direct' = never proxy; anything else is a proxy URL.
en.hint.repos: Local repositories granted for read-only git-route reads (log/diff/show only).
en.hint.routesMirror: Mirrors are third parties that see requested paths; enable only knowingly.
en.hint.token: Write-only: a blank draft keeps the stored token; the Clear control removes it. Prefer tokenEnv.
en.hint.tokenEnv: Environment variable naming the token, e.g. GITHUB_TOKEN.
en.readOnly: This deployment does not allow settings edits.
en.unavailable: This plugin is not loaded, so it cannot be configured right now.
